insurance_bonds.text: eptember 2026 _______________________________________________________________________________ 1. Background The Tourism Grading Council of South Africa (TGCSA) plays a vital role in maintaining and improving the quality of South Africa’s tourism sector. Established under the Tourism Act of 2014, TGCSA is the officially recognised body authorised to implement the national grading system for tourism establishments in South Africa. TGCSA’s vision is to be a recognised, credible and predictable brand that stands for quality and enriches tourist experiences. Through its accredited assessors across all nine provinces, TGCSA supports quality assurance, industry credibility and the enhancement of South Africa’s competitiveness as a tourism destination. To support ongoing assessor engagement, alignment and professional development, TGCSA intends to host its Annual Assessor Conference in the Western Cape and requires the services of a suitably experienced activations agency to plan, coordinate and implement the conference and related activities. 2. Purpose of the RFQ The purpose of this Request for Quotation (RFQ) is to appoint a professional activations agency to conceptualise, coordinate and implement TGCSA’s Annual Assessor Conference and associated activities in the Western Cape.

be responsible for end-to-end event management support, including planning, supplier coordination, branding, delegate management, on-site execution, sponsorship sourcing, Sourcing of marketing collateral, Awards ceremony event management and post-event reporting. 3. Purpose of the Conference The TGCSA Annual Assessor Conference 2026 aims to consolidate assessor expertise, strengthen application of grading and Universal Accessibility criteria, and build capability for consistent, inclusive, and technology-enabled assessments. The conference will also explore how digital transformation and artificial intelligence can enhance quality assurance without compromising credibility, fairness, or standards. The conference will serve as a platform for strategic engagement, practical learning, and cross-sector collaboration among assessors, TGCSA leadership, tourism partners, and industry stakeholders. 4.
